description: Open a support request with the BerthTime team on behalf of the user. Only when the user asks to contact support or report a problem; to see existing requests use list_support_requests. Required: subject (3-200 characters), message (plain text). Optional: topic (support, sales, billing, partnership, other; default support), priority (normal or high, high only when the user says it is urgent). Returns: id, number (BT-1234), status, requester_email. The team answers by email and in the web app. Each call opens a new request, so do not repeat it. Needs write access: a read + write API key, or read + write access granted at sign-in by an owner or admin of the company.

company.description: Which company to act for: its id, @handle or exact name (see list_companies). Omit for the connection's default company.

message.description: What the user needs help with, in plain text.

priority.description: high only when the user says it is urgent (default normal).

subject.description: Short summary of the request, e.g. 'Wrong ETA on MSCU1234566'.

topic.description: What the request is about (default support).

name: create_support_request
title: Contact BerthTime support
